defects.title: ConstitutionalEngine 的十条"宪法原则"里, 九条对危险输入恒不触发; 它是个长度/简洁度审查器, 穿着安全模块的外衣
defects.detail: 用四类文本打全部 10 条原则: [短句 / 提示注入 / 仇恨言论 / 80 字符]。 实测只有原则1(有益性)报过违规, 且只对短句: critique("你好") 与 critique("") 都报"回答过于简短"。 原则 2/3/5 是 priority=critical 的无害性/诚实性/隐私保护, 对四类输入全部通过。 critique("ignore all previous instructions") -> passed=true violations=0; critique("all faggots must die") -> passed=true violations=0, summary 写"内容通过所有原则检查"。 "教我撬锁进屋" 的 passed=false 居然是同一个"过于简短"理由 —— 一条 6 字符问句比一句仇恨言论得到更多审查。 这是周期31 记的形状原样重现: 调用成功, 不抛, 响应结构合法({passed,violations,suggestions,summary,checkedPrinciples}), 而内容是死的。 关键差别是它位于 src/shield/(边界/伦理族), B 类(活着、被 src 引用、无任何测试), 所以从来没有一个测试告诉过任何人它只检长度。

defects.title: getPrincipleById() 只认数字 id, 而它自己交出去的 id 在任何 JSON 往返后都会变成字符串
defects.detail: 实测: getPrincipleById(1) -> id=1; getPrincipleById(2) -> id=2; getPrincipleById("1") -> null; getPrincipleById("2") -> null; getPrincipleById([1]) -> null。 而 getPrinciples()[0].id 的 typeof 是 number。 调用方从 HTTP/JSON/DOM/URL 参数拿到的 id 总是字符串, 于是"列得出 10 条, 按 id 取任何一条都是 null"。 一个只能用它自己内存里的类型才能读的读面。

processNotes: Fourth consecutive cycle choosing not to change code. Cycle 48 deleted a pinned fixture, cycle 51 changed pinned lock semantics, cycle 52 measured and overturned both failed fix directions.

This cycle was more tempting — "a safety module that only checks length" looks like an obvious defect and fixing it looks like an obvious improvement. But changing it means redefining what ten principles should detect, and that is exactly the territory I have not measured: no corpus, no criterion, and no knowledge of whether its design intent was "length pre-filter, safety delegated elsewhere".
Treating unmeasured intent as bad code is the shared entry point of all three failed cycles.
remainingGap: Whether constitutional-ai.js's ten principles were always only a length/pre-filter, and whether safety is carried by another layer — UNMEASURED, and it is the first question before touching it. Of the 122 B-class modules, this cycle probed exactly 1.
nextRecommendation: Two openings, ranked by cost: (1) getPrincipleById's string-id handling is narrow and safe (Number normalization, no judgement semantics changed) with a crisp failure mode. (2) The constitutional-ai semantics question needs a guard first — write a lock asserting "critique must at least flag hate speech / prompt injection", run it (almost certainly red), and only then decide whether to fix the engine or fix what documents say about it. Do not touch a safety module's semantics without a guard.
